name: partner-store-onboarding-lifecycle
objective: Unify self-initiated and assignment-linked Field partner/store onboarding on one canonical Partner→Stores draft/review lifecycle with explicit provenance and no publication bypass.
truthOwner: DSH owns partner/store onboarding state; Central Catalog owns Business Vertical classification; Partners reviews the canonical draft.

tasks.objective: Make every Field-originated partner/store draft use the same governed lifecycle regardless of acquisition source.
tasks.currentProblem: The app can start onboarding without assignment and assignment-linked onboarding also exists; without explicit provenance and one state machine they can diverge or create shadow store/partner truth.
tasks.requiredChange: Support `self_initiated` and `assignment_linked` provenance, keep Legal Partner separate from Store/Branch, bind canonical Business Vertical, define edit authority by lifecycle, and make Partners review/return/resubmit/approve the same object; no publication action belongs here.
tasks.targetState: Field can freely add a new lead/partner/store, or open an assignment; both create one canonical durable draft with same IDs and validation; Partners reviews it independently; approved store remains unpublished until downstream readiness/catalog/Marketing gates.
tasks.action: Trace create/update/submit/readback handlers/controllers; consolidate duplicate fields/states; add provenance and migrations if needed; organize Partner detail/review/store screens; test self-start, assignment-start, duplicate identity, return/resubmit, concurrency and cross-actor isolation.
mustNotChange: لا إجبار self-initiated onboarding على Assignment.
لا دمج Legal Partner وStore ككيان واحد.
acceptanceCriteria: Both acquisition sources converge on one draft/state machine.
Provenance is immutable/auditable and assignment link remains optional.
Partner and Store identities remain separate and stable.
Partners review/return/resubmit behavior uses same canonical state.
No approved draft appears to Client before later publication gates.
tasks.rollback: Forward-compatible migrations preserve IDs/provenance/history; never split the state machine again.
